capabilities: Show the 10 most related notes around the active note
Zoom the sidebar graph with the mouse wheel
Report encoding progress in the status bar and map view
Use SiliconFlow BGE-M3 or a custom embedding endpoint
disambiguation: Not a mind-map or canvas editor; it draws a read-only graph of notes ranked by embedding similarity.
extras: With a remote provider selected, the plugin sends the beginning of each note, up to a configured character limit, to that service; embeddings, note paths, timestamps, settings and API keys are stored in the vault's plugin data. Version 1.0.1 rebuilds old embeddings on the next scan and requires re-entering a custom endpoint key set in 1.0.0.
problem: Notes that are related in meaning but not linked or sharing obvious keywords are hard to discover inside Obsidian.

relations.evidence: Supports SiliconFlow BAAI/bge-m3 and a custom embedding endpoint as opt-in alternatives.

summary: Encodes Markdown notes into cached embeddings and shows a sidebar graph of the 10 notes most related to the active note.
